title: The Departed
synopsis: A South Boston cop undercover in the Mob, a Mob mole undercover in the cops, and a question of who calls whose phone first.

nodes.text: A rodent runs across the railing in the dawn. The city is gray. Justice has not arrived; arithmetic has.
A medal in a frame on a wall in a room nobody goes into. A widow throws the envelope away unopened, then digs it back out.
She raises the boy in a town her family does not know. A photograph on the dresser. She does not say which father he looks like.
